newsitem.title: GERMANY: ProSieben EPS 3.10 DM in 1996 vs 2.00 DM.
newsitem.headline: ProSieben EPS 3.10 DM in 1996 vs 2.00 DM.

text.p: Group earnings per share 3.10 vs 2.00 marks
NOTE - Full name of the German television group is ProSieben Media AG. EPS number is based on the German DVFA standard used by stock market analysts.

Finance director Lothar Lanz told a news conference that EPS, before tax and one-off factors, rose to 5.60 marks from 3.50 marks. The calculations were based on the total of 35 million shares which will exist after a planned July float.
Chief executive Georg Kofler said he expected pre-tax earnings and sales to rise by a double-digit percentage figure this year.
